headline: Superior HealthPlan and Centene Foundation Make $350,000 Investment to Help with Flood Relief in Texas
summary: Superior HealthPlan and Centene Foundation, the philanthropic arm of Centene Corporation (NYSE: CNC), today announced an important investment aimed at addressing flood relief efforts to help Texas communities access resources following recent flooding. This comes as families across the Hill Country and South-Central Texas recover from rainfall that caused catastrophic river flooding, evacuations, infrastructure damage, and loss of life.
